records.quote: Lemma 6 (Li and Fang [20]) For two n-dimensional Archimedean copulas Cψ1 (u) and Cψ2 (u), with φ2 = ψ2^{−1} = sup {x ∈ R : ψ(x) > u}, the right continuous inverse, if φ2 ◦ ψ1 is super-additive, then Cψ1 (u) ≤ Cψ2 (u) for all u ∈ [0, 1]^n .

records.quote: Theorem 9 Let {X1 , . . . , Xn } and {Y1 , . . . , Yn } be two sets of independent random variables each following the multiple outlier LS model such that Xi ∼LS(λ1 , σ1 , F ) and Yi ∼LS(λ1 , ξ1 , F ) for i = 1, . . . , n1 and Xi ∼LS(λ2 , σ2 , F ) and Yi ∼LS(λ2 , ξ2 , F ) for i = n1 + 1, . . . , n. Suppose that (λ1 , λ2 ), (σ1 , σ2 ), (ξ1 , ξ2 ) ∈ D+ (or E+ ). Now if urX (u) is decreasing in u and rX (u) is log-concave and 2-log-convex in u, then (1/σ1 ,...,1/σ1 ,1/σ2 ,...,1/σ2 ) ≺m (1/ξ1 ,...,1/ξ1 ,1/ξ2 ,...,1/ξ2 ) ⟹ X1:n ≥R−hr Y1:n .
